_about: Each hold's guard: who leads it, how its ranks are called, who it takes on and what it issues. Edit freely. People are matched by plugin and base form ID (names are only for reading). Guards the game reports as IsGuard() with this crime faction belong to this guard. A leader with "recruits": true can take someone on; other guards send them to one who can. The player is never added to any vanilla faction: all of this lives in the Living World database.
_ranks_about: In order, lowest first. seats = how many people can hold the rank in this guard at once (null = no limit); vanilla leaders fill the top seats, so the player only reaches them when one opens. Hold guard titles follow the hold guard column of the Cyrodilic Administration rank chart (Guardsman, Sergeant, Lieutenant, Captain, Commander), with Recruit added for probation. The Imperial Legion has its own ladder (Auxiliary .. General), kept for G5 and never granted by guard service. min_days = least days in the rank below before the promotion board will consider it (G3).
_recruit_about: Rules for taking someone on, read by guard/recruit.py. standing is the leader's view of the person: 0.5 x trust + 0.5 x respect from the leader's relationship row, plus what the leader has heard about them (claims), between -1 and 1. A plain request needs standing of at least min_standing; a sponsor (someone in the conversation the leader trusts, who trusts the person at least sponsor_trust) lowers the bar by sponsor_bonus. A thane of this hold is taken on at the Jarl's word (the bounty and serving-elsewhere bars still apply). A leader who thinks well enough of someone (invite_standing) may raise it themselves. redo_days = how long after a dismissal this guard will not take someone back.

orgs.name: the Whiterun Guard
orgs.culture: Imperial-leaning under Jarl Balgruuf, proud of Whiterun's neutrality and its walls; practical, used to giants, bandits and now dragons; a guard is expected to keep the peace without bullying the people they serve.

leaders.name: Commander Caius
leaders.role: captain of the Whiterun city guard

leaders.name: Irileth
leaders.role: the Jarl's housecarl, who commands the guard in battle

orgs.rank_note: The Whiterun Guard is the Jarl's own force; the Imperial Legion's garrison only assists it, and guard ranks carry no rank in the Legion.

pay._about: Weekly wage in gold by rank, owed for every full week served (not while suspended), paid by the member's superior when asked. Each reprimand docks dock_per_reprimand from what is owed. The Lex Imperii pay scale is monthly; these are the weekly shares.

orgs.quarters: a bunk in the Whiterun barracks by the main gate, with a footlocker at its foot
